newsAll.head: Derrick Henry: Scores twice in Week 3 win
newsAll.body: Henry rushed 26 times for 89 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for no gain in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Cowboys.

newsAll.head: Ashton Jeanty: Busy again in Week 3 win
newsAll.body: Jeanty carried the ball 19 times for 56 yards and caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 35-27 win over the Saints.

newsAll.head: Lamar Jackson: Sets up winning FG late after two TDs
newsAll.body: Jackson completed 15 of 20 passes for 186 yards and two touchdowns while rushing six times for 50 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Cowboys.

newsAll.head: Brock Bowers: Makes immediate impact in season debut
newsAll.body: Bowers caught 10 of 13 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-27 win over the Saints.

newsAll.head: Deshaun Watson: Comes up clutch late in upset victory
newsAll.body: Watson completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing 11 times for 45 yards in the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.
